title: ivx: Robust Econometric Inference
description: R package for statistical inference on the coefficients of short- and long-horizon predictive regressions with persistent regressors, using the IVX method of Magdalinos and Phillips (2009) and Kostakis, Magdalinos and Stamatogiannis (2015), its extensions (IVX-AR, residual-augmented and lag-augmented IVX, IVX quantile regression, systems IVX, wild-bootstrap and subsample inference, combined instruments) and the standard non-IVX predictability tests as benchmarks.
